tools.name: get_authoring_context
tools.description: Use first when making a quiz or game. Get supported formats, defaults, account hosting limits and access, and what people do only in Playloop. create_quiz creates a lobby; promise invitation links only when the result contains them.

tools.name: list_quizzes
tools.description: Use when the user wants to find, edit, reuse or replay a game they hosted earlier. Returns their own games newest first, with player counts and replayEditionId when a finished game can be played again exactly; get_quiz retrieves the full content.

tools.name: get_quiz
tools.description: Use before editing or reusing an owned game, or to check who has joined its lobby and is ready. Returns the prepared-content revision, rounds, question count, validation issues, links, and each joined player with readiness and how many questions they submitted. Replay definitions read the frozen edi

tools.name: create_quiz
tools.description: Use for requests to make a quiz or game for friends, or to reuse an earlier quiz as a new game. Supply complete rounds, questions and answers. Creates a real editable lobby and returns host and invitation links. Free access and no contributions are defaults. Use paid single-edition access only with

tools.name: update_quiz
tools.description: Use for follow-up edits after get_quiz. Updates the game at expectedRevision while it is still an editable lobby. Keep stable question/round IDs. Accepts title, blocks and partial settings; omitted fields are preserved. Set contributions to optional with questionsPerContributor for a requested per-p

tools.name: replay_game
tools.description: Use when the user wants to play a finished game again with exactly the same questions. Pass replayEditionId from list_quizzes. Creates a new lobby with a fresh invitation; a rematch cannot be edited (use create_quiz with the old rounds for an edited version). Never starts play. Reuse requestId for i

tools.name: refresh_invitation
tools.description: Use when the user wants a fresh invitation for an existing editable lobby. Previous invitation links stop admitting new players. Returns the replacement link and expiry. Does not start play. Reuse requestId for identical retries.

tools.name: cancel_lobby
tools.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to cancel a lobby that has not started. Its invitation stops working and nobody can play it. A game in progress is stopped in Playloop instead. Reuse requestId for identical retries.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_quiz" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
